items.score: Area score from 9 criteria, each explained
items.transit: Accessibility: lines, frequency and directions, not just distance
items.fifteen: 15-minute city: what you can reach on foot, on real streets
items.green: Green space within 500 m and 1 km
items.environment: Safety, noise, air, industrial areas, seismic risk

items.questions: What to ask at the viewing

confirm.question: Is this the home?
confirm.helper: Check the pin. Distances and scores are measured from here.
confirm.movingQuestion: Move the pin onto the building
confirm.movingHelper: Tap or drag on the map. The report uses exactly this point.

details.intro: Fill in what you know from the listing or from talking to the seller. You can also continue without these details.
details.requiredNote: The location is the only required information.

floor.floorHint: 0 for the ground floor, -1 for a semi-basement

why.title: Why we ask
why.text: Your answers don't change the area score. We use them for comparable prices, yield and the viewing questions. In the report they are marked “declared”.

payment.title: Payment

signedOut.title: Sign in to order the report
signedOut.description: The report stays in your account, under “Reports”, with a PDF and a share link. The address and details you entered stay here.

unlimited.title: Test account: unlimited Smart Check
unlimited.description: You can generate as many reports as you like, without paying.

comingSoon.title: Card payment is coming soon
comingSoon.description: For now, only test accounts can generate the report. Your order stays here: the address and details are not lost.

payment.accessError: We couldn't check your account's access. Reload the page.

items.market: Asking prices and rents in the area, with €/m²
items.questions: Questions to ask at the viewing
items.account: Access in your account, PDF and share link

summary.note: The report describes the area. It can't see the condition of the home.

done.title: Preparing the report
done.description: We are calculating the scores for {{address}}. It usually takes under a minute and the page updates by itself.
done.queued: The order is queued and starts in a few seconds.
done.failedTitle: The report could not be generated
done.failedDescription: It costs you nothing. Try again, and if it happens again, write to us.
done.loadError: We can't read the report's status right now. We'll retry automatically.
done.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can close the page: the report appears in My reports when it is ready.
done.stopped: We stopped checking automatically. The report appears in My reports when it is ready.

empty.title: You have no Smart Check reports yet
empty.description: Check an address and the report appears here, with a PDF and a share link.

pending_payment.title: The report is waiting for payment
pending_payment.description: We prepare it as soon as the order is confirmed.

queued.title: The report is next in line
queued.description: We start preparing it in a few seconds. The page updates by itself.

generating.title: Preparing the report
generating.description: It usually takes less than a minute. The page updates by itself.

ready.title: The report cannot be shown
ready.description: Try again in a few minutes.

failed.title: The report could not be generated
failed.description: We are looking into it. Try again later or write to us.
